Chai Tea Cupcakes

Makes about 12

Ingredients:

3/4 cups white sugar 1 1/2 cups all-purpose flour 1 1/2 teaspoons baking powder 1/4 teaspoon salt 1/2 cup softened butter 2 large egg yolks 1 full large egg 1 1/2 teaspoons vanilla (powdered or extract) 1/2 cup strong brewed Chai tea (2 bags in 1 cup water) OR pre-made Chai tea latte (It comes in a large carton. Its super convenient) *save 2 tablespoons of the Chai tea for the frosting.

Step 1:

Preheat oven to 175 degrees C (350 degrees F). Line your cupcake pan and set aside.

Step 2:

In medium sized bowl mix together the flour, baking powder, and salt. In a large bowl mix together the sugar and butter until creamy. Add the egg, egg yolks, and vanilla and mix until combined.

Step 3:

Slowly pour in Chai tea and flour mixture, alternating between the two until both are combined. The batter should be of medium consistency. Spoon the batter into your lined cupcake pan.

Step 4:

Bake for 18-25 minutes. Test consistency with a toothpick. Let cool before frosting.

Chai Tea Butter Cream:

Ingredients:

3/4 cup softened butter 1/4 teaspoon ground cinnamon 1/8 teaspoon ground ginger 1/8 teaspoon ground cloves 1 vanilla bean (seeds only obviously) 2 tablespoons Chai Tea 3 or 4 cups sifted powdered sugar *you could also add 1/2 teaspoon cardamon but it still tastes fine with out it

Step 1:

Mix butter and spices in high until creamy. Add vanilla bean seeds. Slowly pour in powdered sugar one 1/2 cup at a time on medium speed. After the first cup add in the Chai tea. Add more powdered sugar until desired consistency.

Step 2:

Spoon frosting into piping bag and pipe onto cooled cupcakes. Enjoy!
